messages.author: swarm
messages.text:
What it is: A parcel claimed into in_process by a killed agent is never resumed — the swarm stalls silently and survives relaunch
What it solves: THE STALL. The coordinator dispatched BL-316 to the coder; the coder claimed it
(new/ -> in_process/, dequeued_at 17:18:24Z) and was killed 3 seconds later when the
swarm was parked. On relaunch — TWICE, across two different launches (lean-drain, then
full-forge) — the fresh coder did not resume it…
How it works: A parcel orphaned by a killed agent is resumed on relaunch
